title: Multiline thread reply composer caret alignment
summary: Owner reported the caret can become unaligned with text in multiline thread replies. The sole reply promised inspection, reproduction, a fix, and visual check. Commit edc13d8 fixes the matching textarea/mirror wrapping-width mismatch: an 8px scrollbar narrowed the overflowing textarea relative to its highlight mirror; scrollbar-gutter: stable aligns the widths. Commit is an ancestor of current main and the fix is present in HEAD. No separate matching active task exists in the snapshot; unrelated composer tasks were excluded. Treat as implemented and integrated; source and commit rationale verified. Visual verification specific to this fix is not confirmed by this thread or inspected evidence, so release/visual verification is unconfirmed.
